subject: science
skillName: Patterns of Earth's Features on Maps

items.prompt:
Maps can show Earth features such as
A) mountains and rivers
B) only clouds
C) nothing useful
D) only colors

steps: Maps show features like mountains and rivers.

items.prompt:
Rivers generally flow
A) uphill
B) downhill toward the ocean
C) in circles
D) up into the sky

steps: Rivers flow from higher land to the sea.

items.prompt:
Many mountains form long
A) circles
B) chains
C) dots
D) squares

steps: Mountains often form long chains or ranges.

items.prompt:
Many earthquakes and volcanoes line up along the edges of Earth's
A) rivers
B) plates
C) forests
D) deserts

steps: They cluster where Earth's plates meet.

items.prompt:
Volcanoes around the Pacific Ocean form a
A) ring along its edges
B) single dot
C) random scatter
D) straight line across the middle

steps: Many Pacific volcanoes form a ring along the edges.

items.prompt:
Scientists study earthquake patterns on maps to
A) predict where earthquakes are likely
B) cause earthquakes
C) stop all earthquakes
D) color the map
items.answer: A) predict where earthquakes are likely

items.prompt:
Earthquakes and volcanoes appearing in the same map areas suggests they are
A) unrelated
B) connected to the same plate edges
C) caused by rivers
D) scattered randomly
items.answer: B) connected to the same plate edges

steps: Their overlap points to plate edges as the shared cause.

items.prompt:
Describing a PATTERN of features is more useful than a plain list because a pattern
A) hides the data
B) lets you predict where features are likely
C) changes the map
D) is always wrong
items.answer: B) lets you predict where features are likely

steps: A pattern gives a rule that supports prediction.
